title: Awaitable-rejection tests omit forward fail-closed gate assertion
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:747-752, 777-784: neither new persist/clear awaitable test asserts the forward gate — after poisoning, _ensure_persistence_healthy_locked (provisioning.py:435-437) must make any subsequent install/clear raise RuntimeError 'provision verifier is poisoned after persistence failure'. Without that pin, a regression that poisons state but drops the health gate (something advancing later — the core qzxv property) is uncaught.
